en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘I stand and Pray Salaat in Makkah, and the woman is seated in front of him, or passes by’. So heasws said: ‘There is no problem. But rather, Makkah has been named as Bakkah, because therein ‘تَبُكُّ’ wail (Baka’a) the men and the women’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘
I stand up for Salat (prayer) in Makkah and a woman is sitting in front of me or is passing. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not harmful. It is called Bakkah because both men and women weep there.’”
